meta.method: 4PL grid MAP per model (g=0.25 for mcq) + per-cell grid posterior of tau with empirical-Bayes topic offsets (sigma_gamma=2, sigma_eps by moments); draws: paired cluster bootstrap of events within topic; hazard/abstain: Beta shrinkage (5 pseudo-obs) over items with t > tau + 2s
meta.note: PRIOR index, not a topic-resolved measurement: fitted from the apoorvumang/knowledge-cutoff benchmark (report_answers.json of 2026-11-23), whose events end 2026-06-30, so cutoffs later than about 2026-06 cannot be resolved and read as 'at least 2026-06'. Probe 'current' is kc's 'direct' probe (no date in the prompt), 'mcq' is kc's multiple choice. Most topic cells hold few or no items and are shrunk to the model's global cutoff; only arts_entertainment, government, elections, sports, business_economy and law_crime move away from it (see meta.hyper gamma). Global priors: direct-probe 4PL fits from the research (Fable 25.8, Sol 27.75, Neon 26.0; sd 3). Replace with an index fitted from the topic-stratified probe set (cutoffmix bench run/fit) when available.
